pages.text: A cable network moves its cargo the instant it is asked to. Nothing is ever stored inside a cable: what the network cannot place this tick is refused, so a cable run is never a hidden buffer.$(br2)There is one cable per kind of cargo, plus a universal one that joins every network it touches.
Forge Energy. Works with anything that speaks it, including Mekanism machines and Flux Networks.
Carries all of them at once, and bridges networks of different kinds.
